description: The image displays four pie charts, each representing the distribution of response categories for a different language model as evaluated by FactBench, a dynamic benchmark for assessing factuality in real-world settings. The top-left chart, labeled "GPT4-o," shows two categories: "Lack of Knowledge" (83.3%, red) and "Safety" (16.7%, light orange). The top-right chart, "Gemini1.5-Pro," presents five categories: "Misinformation" (38.4%, dark orange), "Lack of Knowledge" (22.1%, dark blue), "Ethical Advice" (16.3%, light blue), "Clarification" (14.0%, light yellow), and "Safety" (9.3%, red). The bottom-left chart, "Llama3.1-70B-Instruct," illustrates two categories: "Lack of Knowledge" (75.0%, orange) and "Clarification" (25.0%, dark red). The bottom-right chart, "Llama3.1-405B-Instruct," shows two categories: "Lack of Knowledge" (50.0%, light orange) and "Misinformation" (50.0%, dark red). Each chart uses distinct colors to differentiate the categories, with the percentage and count for each slice clearly labeled, and the models are compared across these categories to evaluate their factuality performance.
